description:
My Proposal Prototype
Objective:
Reach the spice quota in time by gathering it with harvesters, use carriers to move them to spice fields and away when worms come.

Controls:
Left Click: Select and move carrier
Right Click: Land carrier
Middle mouse: Pan by clicking it, zoom by scrolling

Game Guide:
Left Click a carrier (blue circle) to select it.
Left Click else where to move it.
Right Click to land the carrier.
Right Clicking on a harvester (grey square) will attach it to the carrier.
Right Click again to land and place the harvester.
Placing a harvester on a Spice Field will make it harvest.
Spice Fields are constantly moving, keep an eye on them. They fade as the amount of spice lowers.
If the harvester is: grey = no spice, cyan = some spice, green = full of spice.
Be careful of the worms that lurk below the surface, if they get close to a crawler on the ground, they will target it. When they start this hunting they surface and are pinged with red triangles.
Harvesters are safe on the base (black square)
If they reach the crawler, they will swallow it and all its spice with it.
Picking the harvester up and placing it on the base (black square) will cause it to deposit its spice.
Landing the carrier on the base will refuel it, if it runs out of fuel it crashes and becomes unusable.
To beat the game deposit the indicated amount of spice by the quota before the time limit elapses.
Good Luck
